query:
*[_type == "ticketType" && active == true && (category == $category || (!defined(category) && $category == "admission"))] | order(order asc){
    _id,
    name,
    "slug": slug.current,
    price,
    regularPrice,
    description,
    capacity,
    releasedQuantity,
    earlyBirdCutoff,
    order,
    demo,
    provisional,
    requiresDaySelection,
    category,
    capacityPool,
    headcountPerUnit,
    show,
  }

result.description: Single-day admission to the National Show during the early-bird window.
result.name: Early-Bird Exhibition Ticket

result.description: Single-day general admission to the National Show — choose your day.
result.name: Day Visitor Ticket

result.description: Full-weekend admission to the National Show.
result.name: Weekend Pass

result.description: Full-weekend admission to the National Show at the early-bird price.
result.name: Weekend Pass (Early Bird)

result.description: Reception access plus full-weekend admission to the National Show.
result.name: VIP Ticket

result.description: Test data — never real pricing. Used to exercise the ticketing pipeline end-to-end in isolation from the real show. Never active except for a brief, human-supervised test window.
result.name: General Admission (Fictional Test Show)
